# TelemetryContext

interface [TelemetryContext](index.html)

An abstraction for a telemetry context, capable of bridging into ThreadLocal storage via its [attach](attach.html) and [detach](detach.html) methods for synchronous tracing, or being carried across coroutine boundaries via [asContextElement](as-context-element.html).
